judge.rationale: The candidate fulfills all the requirements stated in the issue, including making `createContext` optional when the router has no context so the issue's exact `localLink({ router })` syntax works. It places the implementation in the same file (`packages/client/src/links/localLink.ts`), exports it from `packages/client/src/links.ts`, and uses the same core primitives (`callProcedure`, `raceAbortSignals`, `getErrorShape`, `TRPCClientError.from`). However, it has a bug with real transformers like `superjson` because it passes `transformer.input.serialize(input)` into `callProcedure` (which expects unserialized input) and transforms subscription chunks before checking `isTrackedEnvelope`. Compared to the reference PR, it also misses async generator support for queries/mutations, iterator resource cleanup on abort, and subscription reconnection with `lastEventId` and connection state tracking, plus it leaves `.lore/dod.md` in the diff.
